title: Father & Toddler Girl, Suburban Bungalow Lawn - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A touching mid-century American snapshot featuring a smiling father crouching on a residential sidewalk beside his young toddler daughter. The father wears a neat collared shirt, trousers, and dark leather shoes with his hair styled in a tidy side-part typical of the post-WWII era. The young blonde girl wears a pale knit cardigan, a hair bow, and white walking booties. A manicured front lawn, a craftsman-style bungalow, and overhead utility lines form the backdrop, capturing the quintessential suburban family life of the post-war baby boom.
